scripts.dev:worker: npm run build && wrangler dev --config dist/server/wrangler.json
scripts.build: astro build && node scripts/inject-csp-hashes.mjs && node scripts/generate-integrity-manifest.mjs && node scripts/merge-wrangler-routes.mjs
scripts.deploy: npm run build && wrangler deploy --config dist/server/wrangler.json
scripts.deploy:production: npm run build && node scripts/merge-wrangler-routes.mjs wrangler.production.json && wrangler deploy --config dist/server/wrangler.json

BUCKET.description: Holds encrypted uploads for 1 hour, 1 day or 7 days. An hourly cron deletes them when they expire. R2 has to be enabled on the account first.

SECURITY_BUDGET.description: Rate limits, upload quotas and proof-of-work replay protection.

CHAT.description: Chat rooms. They relay encrypted messages and keep only the room settings, never a message.

WHITEBOARD.description: Whiteboard rooms. They relay encrypted strokes and never store them.

ROOM_TURN_SECRET.description: Signs the short-lived grants that let room members fetch TURN credentials for calls. Any random string of 32 bytes or more, for example from `openssl rand -hex 32`.

RATE_LIMIT_SECRET.description: Keys the hashes of client addresses used for rate limits. Any random string of 32 bytes or more, for example from `openssl rand -hex 32`.

UPLOAD_PASS_SECRET.description: Signs proof-of-work challenges and upload passes. Any random string of 32 bytes or more, for example from `openssl rand -hex 32`.

CLOUDFLARE_TURN_TOKEN_ID.description: Needed for voice and video calls, which always go through a TURN relay so members never see each other’s IP address. Create a TURN key under **Realtime → TURN Server** in the Cloudflare dashboard and paste its key ID here. Leave empty to deploy without calls.

CLOUDFLARE_TURN_API_TOKEN.description: The API token of that TURN key. Leave empty to deploy without calls.
